title: Insider describes place where bodies are stored

tellings.quote: One of them has talked about a place in which bodies are stored where they stored.

plain: A former military or intelligence insider is said to have described a place where bodies, by implication not human, are stored. An online UFO researcher who goes by UAPGerb passes this on from insiders he does not name, without saying where the place is. If true, it would mean someone is keeping physical remains of beings from elsewhere.
